$Comment: A woodcutter's luck on the Winter Bauble find, on a server running MMO Skill Tree: the breaker's
gathering yield (the stat GatherYield, which Woodcutting's talents raise while a hatchet is in hand and
the Christmas Set's MMO half raises), read through hytale:stat in whole points at a weight of 1. The
file name is the factor id. The bauble row (BonusRows/SeasonsOfOrbis/Christmas_Bauble_Find.json) adds
it to its Chance, a percent, so each point of yield is one more percent, up to the row's Clamp; the row
writes AddsYield false, so the yield is counted here once and never a second time by the break itself.
Requires, the plain hytale:mod_installed condition with Min 1, drops this file at load where MMO Skill
Tree is missing: the factor is then absent on purpose, so it adds 0 to the row's Chance there and
nothing reports it as unknown. Its id carries no Mmo_ prefix because the bauble row, which every
server loads, names it as a term.
